account: It is day 0, shortly after noon, and I am home for my scheduled lunch after the morning market walk. I have heard little unusual: several townsfolk reported seeing the baker carrying a sack of wheat at the bakery. That seems consistent with bread-making, although I have not seen the delivery myself or learned anything further about it. No other local news was offered. The main unresolved matter is my three o'clock tea appointment, which names only a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank. The secretary has the appointment book and went to confirm the host and exact address, promising to report before tea, either here at noon or at the office after one. I have not yet received that report. My afternoon appointments are town accounts at one, tea at three, and the office again at four-thirty. So far I have no evidence of trouble or of any hidden purpose behind today's activities.
